title: FreeHub Airtime Dash — October 2026
eligibility: South African residents aged 18 or over. FreeHub staff and their immediate families are excluded.
contactPolicy: FreeHub will contact the selected winner through the email address on their FreeHub account by 4 November 2026. Airtime fulfilment is handled manually; the winner will need to provide a supported South African mobile number and network privately.
winnerPolicy: Public leaderboards and challenge links show your chosen public nickname and score. Email addresses, mobile numbers and account identifiers are not published. Obtain separate consent before publishing a winner's real name or photograph.
rules: FreeHub Airtime Dash is free to enter. No purchase or marketing subscription is required. Eligibility: South African residents aged 18 or over, excluding FreeHub staff and their immediate families. The October competition opens on activation after deployment and closes at the end of 31 October 2026 in South African time (00:00 on 1 November 2026, UTC+02:00). Players must sign into their FreeHub account, accept these rules and confirm eligibility before ranked play. Anonymous practice is a 25-second demonstration and does not enter the competition. Ranked players start with three lives. Score and remaining lives carry across progressively harder levels; lives never refill. There is no final level or gameplay time limit. All ranked players receive the same versioned conditions. The highest eligible server-verified score wins R500 airtime. A tie goes to the earliest server verification of that exact score. Only progress verified before closing qualifies, including progress from unfinished runs. At closing the verified competition score freezes. Later play is unranked and does not count or transfer into another month. Backgrounding does not pause ranked simulation. Connection loss or inactivity preserves only previously verified progress. Repeat attempts are allowed, subject to abuse prevention and one active ranked session per account. Challenges and referrals do not add prize points or improve a competition score. Manipulated, invalid or ineligible entries may be rejected or disqualified following review. FreeHub reviews the leading scores and confirms the winner after closing. The winner will be contacted by 4 November 2026 through their FreeHub account email. The winner has seven calendar days after notification to respond and privately supply the mobile number and network required for manual airtime fulfilment. An unclaimed or ineligible prize may be offered to the next eligible player using the same score and tie-break rules. FreeHub processes account, game verification and challenge records to run the competition and prevent abuse, as described in the Airtime Dash privacy notice on the game page. Marketing consent remains separate. Public scores use a nickname; private contact details are not published. Questions can be raised through the FreeHub contact page. Material entry conditions and gameplay versions are locked once ranked play begins.
